thread:
maria: Starting change window for serve-runtime v2.3.1 -> v2.4.0, canary at 5% now. preflight looked green but watch dashboards :eyes:
deploy-bot: Rollout started: service=serve-runtime env=eu-west canary=5% id=roll-20260401-1719
oncall-bot: Alert: embeddings-route p99 latency increased by 120ms over baseline in eu-west (last 3m) :warning:
maria: saw that, digging into SLO dashboard (embeds.uptime, embeds.p95/p99). no 5xx spike yet.
devon: can you share the quick gif of the dashboard? I see a tail starting.
maria: pasted link https://dash.redwood/embeds?range=5m :point_up:
sam: if p99 keeps rising we should pause and pin to v2.3.1. low blast radius but embeddings are high QPS.
alex: agreed. ask: is this KV cache warming for kvcache-prefill? sometimes causes tail on p99.
maria: checked cache metrics — hit rate unchanged. CPU spiking on t4x nodes for the embed shard.
devon: running a canary dump now, attaching logs:
```
kubectl logs deploy/serve-runtime-canary -n prod --tail=200 | grep embed
[2026-04-01T17:20:15Z] decode_batch took 42ms
[2026-04-01T17:20:21Z] attention_step 350ms (outlier)
```
sam: that attention_step outlier lines up with p99 blips. could be new kernel selection in 2.4.0.
linda: from release notes, v2.4.0 switched to fused-attn-kernel by default for long seqs. maybe falling back not triggered.
maria: ok plan: pause traffic shift, pin traffic for embeds route to v2.3.1, keep rest of canary. will open a rollback if we see error budget touch.
deploy-bot: Command received: /rollout pause --target roll-20260401-1719 --scope=route:embeddings --by=maria
oncall-bot: Incident note created: INC-20260401-embeds-p99. linked to thread.
devon: i'll toggle kernel flag on the canary to force safe-kernel and re-run perf probe: `/exec set-flag fused_attn=off --deployment serve-runtime-canary`
maria: doing pin now: `/traffic pin set route=embeddings version=v2.3.1 --reason "p99 spike"`
deploy-bot: Traffic pin complete for route=embeddings -> v2.3.1 (effective immediately).
sam: nice. can we add a short-term alert to mute p99 noise for 10m to avoid repeated pager churn? keep critical alerts on 5xx.
alex: +1 for muting p99 noise, but keep eyeballs. also schedule postmortem if we need rollback.
maria: created short follow-up: will run 10m perf probe, if p99 returns to baseline we'll continue ramp. if not, we'll rollback the canary and open a postmortem. tagging @devex for release notes update. :white_check_mark:
linda: adding note to release notes draft: downgrade fused-attn default until further perf validation.
oncall-bot: Update: p99 trending down after kernel flag change (5m window). will monitor next 10m.
maria: thanks everyone. leaving pin in place until next ops sync. drafting a short release-note blurb and ops checklist.
